title: 2006 AMC 10B Problem 6
statement: A region is bounded by semicircular arcs constructed on the sides of a square whose sides measure \(\tfrac{2}{\pi},\) as shown. What is the perimeter of this region?

solutions.text:
Each side has length \(\tfrac{2}{\pi},\) the diameter of a semicircular arc, so each arc has length \(\tfrac12\pi\cdot\tfrac{2}{\pi}=1.\)

The boundary consists of four such arcs, so the perimeter is \(4\cdot1=4.\)

Thus, the correct answer is D.
hints: Each side of the square is the diameter of one semicircular arc
A semicircle on diameter \(d\) has arc length \(\tfrac12\pi d\)
